schema: data/moves v1 (style of throwdown.json): every number = {v, basis}; basis = sample id + skeleton field + frame/time
conventions: ref angles: knee 0 = straight, torso_lean 0 = upright, arm_abd 0 = arm hanging, elbow 0 = straight (MediaPipe skeleton). game.* knee = interior angle (180 = straight) as in rider.js. t = clip time (0 = user segment start).
other_sources: pro_EiPZ7dODY0E_1 (4分, 0.9 s, oblique, regular) — the best sample is only 0.3 s (the raise itself is ~2 frames), so TIMING comes from this one
segment_notes: best pro_ARCk35WWnbk_10: 0.3 s, front/back camera, left arm jumps from 52 to 127 deg abduction between f1 and f2 (one frame) and drops at f8 — the segment holds the pose, not the motion. pro_EiPZ7dODY0E_1: rise -0.004->0.33 s, hold to 0.705 s, half-way down at 0.872 s.

stance.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_10 refskel stance(): travel method; agrees with view.stance

arm_up_abd_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_10 ang.arm_abd_L main peak f4 t0.03 (smoothed 130.9, raw 127.1, half-height -0.03..0.1)

arm_up_elbow_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_10 ang.elbow_L median over the arm_abd_L half-height window over t -0.03..0.1

arm_other_abd_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_10 ang.arm_abd_R median over the same window over t -0.03..0.1

knee_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_10 ang.knee_max median over the same window over t -0.03..0.1

torso_lean_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_10 ang.torso_lean median over the same window over t -0.03..0.1

rise_s.basis: pro_EiPZ7dODY0E_1 ang.arm_abd_L smoothed: 10% -> 90% of (peak 141.8 - start 88.0) at t -0.004 -> 0.33

lower_s.basis: pro_EiPZ7dODY0E_1 ang.arm_abd_L smoothed: 90% at 0.705 -> 50% at 0.872, doubled

timing_peak_abd_deg.basis: pro_EiPZ7dODY0E_1 ang.arm_abd_L main peak f15 t0.5 (smoothed 141.8, raw 136.3, half-height 0.33..0.75)

timing_elbow_deg.basis: pro_EiPZ7dODY0E_1 ang.elbow_L median over its arm_abd_L half-height window over t 0.33..0.75

game._: proposed targets for the rider.js dance-arm raise (act.lz/le/ly targets, eL easing). Not wired yet.

upAbd.basis: ref.arm_up_abd_deg capped at 90 = shoulder height (Cheney: outside arm floats to about shoulder height, NEVER overhead; the reference 131 deg is overhead)

otherAbd.basis: ref.arm_other_abd_deg capped at 35 (inside arm low; never both up)
